reconstruction_summary: Reran V2 (the agent's headline 'best'): per-segment integer-sample lag alignment of yaw_rate_pred_rads to yaw_rate_meas_rads via the agent's best_lag/shift functions (max_lag=10), then per-segment bias removal on the aligned residual.
notes: V2 is a non-parametric per-segment post-processor (lag + bias) computed from each canonical segment itself — no fitted parameters carried across segments. Applied uniformly to all 545 Ford segments (both Mach-E and F-150 Lightning, even though the agent only scored Mach-E in their report).
